learn.title: Learn
learn.lead: Short lessons to invest with judgement, from zero to filing your taxes.
learn.path_start_body: What you buy, where, and what it costs: stocks, funds, brokers and orders.
learn.path_returns_body: How to measure what you earn and what you risk, and compare it with the market.
learn.path_tax_es_body: Savings base, FIFO, losses, dividends and the forms due every year.
learn.disclaimer: Educational content, not advice. Tax rules change: check figures and deadlines with the Spanish tax agency.
